shop.name: Al Aziz Car Restoration & Workshop
shop.description: We specialize in full vehicle restoration, body work, engine rebuilding, and custom paint jobs. With years of hands-on experience and a dedicated team of mechanics, we bring vehicles back to life — from classic rebuilds to modern collision repair. Every job gets our full attention, whether it's a full restoration or a quick touch-up.
